summarize.label: Summarize this page
summarize.prompt: Summarize this page: start with a one- or two-sentence overview, then list the key points.

keyPoints.label: Key points
keyPoints.prompt: Extract the key information from this page (conclusions, data, steps, caveats, etc.) as a list. Don't leave out important details.

explain.label: Explain this page
explain.prompt: Explain in plain English what this page is about, who it's for, and which parts are most worth attention.

placeholder.notConfigured: Configure a chat model in settings first
placeholder.withTools: Ask about this page, or let the AI use page tools to do something for you…
placeholder.default: Ask about this page, e.g. "What's the conclusion of this article?"

chat.inputHint: Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line

empty.title: How can I help?
empty.description: Summarize pages or ask questions about them. Select text on a page and click "Ask AI" — it opens here with the selection attached.
empty.descriptionWithTools: Summarize pages or ask questions about them. Select text on a page and click "Ask AI" — it opens here with the selection attached. This page also provides {count} tools, which the AI can use to act on it for you.
empty.descriptionWithTools_one: Summarize pages or ask questions about them. Select text on a page and click "Ask AI" — it opens here with the selection attached. This page also provides {count} tool, which the AI can use to act on it for you.

tool.mayModify: This tool may modify page data
tool.confirmSave: Review the tool definition above before saving

settings.modelHint: Used by the side panel assistant and selection actions like explain, summarize, and polish. Pick a capable model that supports tool calling. The translation model is configured separately in settings and can be a faster one.
settings.modelHintInherited: Used by the side panel assistant and selection actions like explain, summarize, and polish. Pick a capable model that supports tool calling. The translation model is configured separately in settings and can be a faster one. Currently following the translation model; saving makes it separate.
settings.confirmToolsHint: Tools provided via WebMCP that aren't declared read-only (they may submit forms, place orders, etc.) ask for your confirmation before running
settings.confirmToolsHintUnsupported: Tools provided via WebMCP that aren't declared read-only (they may submit forms, place orders, etc.) ask for your confirmation before running. WebMCP isn't enabled in this browser yet: enable "WebMCP for testing" in chrome://flags to use it

agent.toolNotFound: Tool "{name}" does not exist. Please use only the provided tools
agent.rejectedByUser: The user rejected this tool call
agent.noResult: (Tool ran successfully with no return value)
agent.maxSteps: The model has called tools {count} times in a row without finishing, so it stopped here.
agent.maxSteps_one: The model has called a tool {count} time in a row without finishing, so it stopped here.
agent.maxStepsHistory: The model has called tools {count} times in a row without finishing, so it stopped here. You can add details and continue.
agent.maxStepsHistory_one: The model has called a tool {count} time in a row without finishing, so it stopped here. You can add details and continue.

errors.readPageFailed: Couldn't read the current page: browser built-in pages aren't supported. If the page was open before DevGo was installed, refresh it and try again
errors.noResponse: The page didn't respond. Refresh the page and try again
errors.scriptNotReady: DevGo's script on this page isn't ready. Refresh the page and try again
errors.navigatedNoResult: The tool ran, but the page navigated and no result was found on the new page
errors.toolMissing: Tool "{name}" wasn't found on this page
errors.webmcpDisabled: WebMCP is not enabled in this browser
errors.llmNotConfigured: AI translation isn't configured: enter the base URL and model in settings
errors.chatNotConfigured: AI isn't configured: enter the base URL and model

unsupported.note: The page's own WebMCP tools need "WebMCP for testing" enabled in chrome://flags

unavailable.title: This page can't be read
unavailable.description: Browser built-in pages, the extension store, and similar pages don't allow extension access. If this is a normal web page, refresh it and try again.

loading.title: Checking this page…
loading.description: Reading tools registered by the page and its iframes.

empty.title: No tools on this page yet
empty.description: Let the AI look at this page and build a tool for you, such as search, reading a list or checking orders. Once saved, just ask on this site and the AI will use it.

webmcp.summary: This page provides {count} tools. Describe what you need in Chat and the AI will call them
webmcp.summary_one: This page provides {count} tool. Describe what you need in Chat and the AI will call it
webmcp.readOnlyHint: Read-only tool; won't modify page data

create.title: What tool do you need?
create.placeholder: Describe what it should do, e.g. "search products on this site and return name, price and link"
create.exampleSearch: Search this site and return titles and links
create.exampleList: Read the list data on this page
create.exampleDetail: Read the key details on this page
create.hint: The AI inspects the page and test-runs it; you confirm before saving
create.busy: The AI is replying; create after it finishes
create.prompt: Build a site tool for this website: {request}

recorder.unsupportedPage: This page can't be recorded (browser pages, extension store, etc.)
recorder.recordingHint: Just use the page as usual; recording continues across page navigations. To output data, click "Pick data" on the recording bar at the top of the page, then click the content to read.
recorder.pickHint: Click the content to read, Esc to cancel
recorder.name: Tool name
recorder.nameHint: Starts with a letter; letters, digits and underscores only. The AI calls the tool by this name
recorder.descriptionHint: Say what it does and when to use it; the AI decides whether to call it from this
recorder.matchesHint: Domains or wildcard paths separated by spaces, e.g. github.com github.com/*/issues*
recorder.readOnlyHint: Turn on for flows that only read and don't change data; they then run without confirmation
recorder.fromStartHint: Go to {url} before running; otherwise run on the current page
recorder.invalidParamName: Parameter names start with a letter and use letters, digits and underscores
recorder.passwordNotRecorded: Password not recorded; passed in when running
recorder.testHint: A test run first returns to the URL where recording started, then runs the steps
